items.title: India should scrap capital gains tax on foreign investors: Edelweiss chief
items.description: Edelweiss Financial Services Chairman Rashesh Shah said scrapping capital gains tax for FPIs could help revive inflows into Indian equities and support the rupee amid heavy overseas selling

items.title: Wall Street rebounds as chip stocks rally after heavy AI-related selloff
items.description: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed higher, led by technology and semiconductor stocks, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gaining 4.2%. All three major US indexes, however, posted weekly losses
